title: Giraffe wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='42' y='44' width='16' height='34' rx='7' fill='#f6c945'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='54' rx='3.2' ry='2.6' fill='#b8791e'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='63' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#b8791e'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='71' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#b8791e'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='22' ry='13' fill='#f6c945'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='77' rx='3.4' ry='2.8' fill='#b8791e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='3.6' ry='2.8' fill='#b8791e'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='77' rx='3.4' ry='2.8' fill='#b8791e'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='88' width='7' height='10' rx='3' fill='#e0a82e'/>
  <rect x='46' y='89' width='7' height='9' rx='3' fill='#f6c945'/>
  <rect x='58' y='88' width='7' height='10' rx='3' fill='#e0a82e'/>
  <!-- ossicones -->
  <rect x='41' y='24' width='4' height='9' rx='2' fill='#e0a82e'/>
  <rect x='55' y='24' width='4' height='9' rx='2' fill='#e0a82e'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='24' r='3.4' fill='#c9801a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='24' r='3.4' fill='#c9801a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#f6c945'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='8' ry='5.5' fill='#f3b95c'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='43' rx='1.4' ry='1.8' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='43' rx='1.4' ry='1.8' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='33' r='2.4' fill='#3b2a12'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='33' r='2.4' fill='#3b2a12'/>
  <circle cx='45.8' cy='32.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff6d8'/>
  <circle cx='55.8' cy='32.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff6d8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='31' rx='4.5' ry='2.8' fill='#e0a82e' transform='rotate(-25 35 31)'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='31' rx='4.5' ry='2.8' fill='#e0a82e' transform='rotate(25 65 31)'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,4 38,24 62,24' fill='#ff5d8f'/>
  <polygon points='50,4 44,16 56,16' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <rect x='37' y='22' width='26' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#6ad0ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='4' r='3.4' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <polygon points='44,16 50,9 56,16' fill='#8b5cf6'/>
</svg>
